objective: Verificar en datos reales el enlace atomico Venta.Documento_ID hacia Comanda_Detalle.Cd_Id, sin exponer datos personales. Solo agregados.

queries.name: sale_line_document_identity_coverage
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS base_datos, vd.Sc_Cve_Sucursal AS sucursal, vd.Vn_Tabla AS tabla_documento, COUNT_BIG(*) AS partidas_venta, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.Cd_Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partidas_comanda_id, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.Cd_Id IS NOT NULL AND vd.Pr_Cve_Producto=cd.Pr_Cve_Producto THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partidas_producto_coincide FROM Venta vd LEFT JOIN Comanda_Detalle cd ON cd.Co_Folio=vd.Vn_Documento AND cd.Cd_Id=vd.Vn_Documento_ID WHERE vd.Sc_Cve_Sucursal IN ('0023','0021') AND vd.Vn_Fecha >= DATEADD(day,-31,CONVERT(datetime,'20261007',112)) GROUP BY vd.Sc_Cve_Sucursal,vd.Vn_Tabla
